name: Cairokee
description: Egyptian rock band Cairokee arrives in Berlin at a culturally charged moment. Born out of the Arab Spring, the band has become one of the most politically significant musical acts in the Middle East, blending Arabic pop, rock, and electronic music with lyrics that speak to a generation seeking change. Their Berlin show represents a rare opportunity to witness a band that has soundtracked revolution, navigated censorship, and remained a voice for youth across the region. This is music with real stakes.
